title: Microservices Architecture
intro: Microservices interview questions test architectural judgement, not just framework knowledge — service decomposition, API gateway patterns, service discovery, client- vs server-side load balancing, circuit breaker / retry / bulkhead / time limiter (Resilience4j), saga and outbox patterns, distributed tracing (correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry, Zipkin), config management (Spring Cloud Config), service mesh (sidecars, Istio basics), and the migration patterns from monolith to microservices (strangler fig). Pair this with the REST API and Messaging/Kafka pages for the full microservices interview surface.
